{{Top|leg}}
'''Keane's Emporium''' was a high-tech shop located in [[Point Nadir]]. It was owned by [[Liash Keane]], but the day-to-day activities were handled by her subordinates. It was known to have the best selection of technology, but was very expensive. It also provided services such as [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]], forgery and buying and selling identities.
